newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares end higher, focus on PT.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares end higher, focus on PT.

text.p: 1750 GMT - Portuguese shares ended higher, with 32 percent of the total turnover of 8.9 billion escudos taken up by Portugal Telecom, which rose on anticipation of the announcement of a strategic ally. A government source told Reuters that PT was discussing its choice of a strategic ally today. Market sources said PT would choose Concert, a venture between British Telecom and the U.S. MCI Communications Corp, as its strategic ally. Dealers noted selling of PT shares by a foreign investor.
The positive tone of foreign markets and hopes of a Portuguese key rate cut on Friday also helped sentiment, dealers said.
Dealers said BCP shares were marked down because the stock traded ex-dividend.
